title: TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours: Prompt-Payment Percentage on a Repeat Order
content:
**Repeat-order payment schedule.** When no late fee has been assessed on the current TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours block in the twelve months before the order date, meaning fees dated after the same day twelve months earlier, and its block invoice was paid in full on the day it was posted, the order earns 1 percent; when no such late fee was assessed and the invoice was paid in full on a later day, it earns 0.5 percent; when a late fee was assessed in those twelve months, or the invoice is not yet paid in full, it earns none. The percentage is granted to the repeat-order price.

Only payments applied to the block invoice's own invoice number count, and the payment completing the invoice dates its full payment.

| Late fee on the block in the twelve months | Block invoice paid in full | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| none | on its posting day | 1 |
| none | on a later day | 0.5 |
| none | not yet | none |
| one or more | any | none |

Hypothetical cases for an order dated 10 June: a late fee dated 10 June of the previous year is outside the twelve months, one dated 11 June of the previous year is inside. An invoice posted 3 March and completed by a second payment on 20 March was paid in full on 20 March, a later day.
